name: zumbra-mcp
title: Zumbra: shielded Zcash wallet for AI agents
description: Headless Zcash wallet for AI agents: encrypted vault, shielded sends, a spending policy the agent cannot edit

tools.name: wallet_status
tools.description: Get wallet status: sync height, balance, primary address, policy summary, and seed source

tools.name: wallet_lock
tools.description: Lock the wallet — clears the seed from memory. Signing fails until the operator restarts the server. Read-only tools (balance, status, transactions) still work.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get pool-specific wallet balance (shielded orchard, shielded sapling, transparent, unconfirmed)

tools.name: propose_send
tools.description: Create a send proposal. Returns fee and amount for review before signing. Call confirm_send to broadcast.

tools.name: confirm_send
tools.description: Sign and broadcast the pending send proposal. Uses seed from server memory — never pass seed as argument.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Get recent transaction history with memos

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Get current sync status: synced height, latest height, whether syncing, any connection errors

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Validate a Zcash address and return whether it is valid and its type

tools.name: vote_eligibility
tools.description: Check voting eligibility for a governance round. Returns total eligible ZEC, number of notes, and number of bundles needed for delegation.

tools.name: ironwood_plan
tools.description: Read an Ironwood transfer plan from the current SDK. Requires an unlocked wallet seed for derivation; does not sign, persist or broadcast a transfer.

tools.name: ironwood_confirm
tools.description: Unavailable legacy Ironwood execution entry point. Does not sign or create a schedule; use the wallet app's reviewed SDK migration flow.

tools.name: ironwood_status
tools.description: Read the current Ironwood migration state from the wallet's SDK database, including confirmed transactions and next due height.

tools.name: ironwood_pause
tools.description: Unavailable legacy pause entry point. Cannot pause the SDK migration runner; use the wallet app managing the transfer.

tools.name: ironwood_resume
tools.description: Unavailable legacy resume entry point. Cannot resume the SDK migration runner; use the wallet app managing the transfer.

tools.name: pay_x402
tools.description: Pay an HTTP 402 paywall. Pass the full 402 response body. Returns txid and a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value to include when retrying the original request.
